alerts.message: A creatinine result appears only in pasted lab text, so its date is unknown. Check when it was taken and enter it as a dated lab result for a patient on TDF.

alerts.message: Proteinuria (or trace protein) is mentioned in notes. Consider follow-up assessment and management per local guidance.

alerts.title: Renal Function Decline
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring creatinine in patients on TDF. Patient's creatinine has been rising from 0.9 mg/dL in 2020 to 1.4 mg/dL, with eGFR at 52 mL/min/1.73m2. TDF is a known cause of renal impairment, but other factors like dehydration or sepsis should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor creatinine and eGFR closely, assess for dehydration or sepsis

Substitute with AZT.
